name: Prairie Wolf Paw
summary: Across Mulgore, prairie wolves hunt the plains, and their paws are gathered for a shaman's work. In Bloodhoof Village, Mull Thunderhorn joins them with plainstrider talons to make a cleansing totem.

sections.title: Natural Reagents of the Plains
sections.body: Prairie wolves hunt in packs across Mulgore’s grasses, alongside prairie stalkers and their pack alphas. They threaten young hunters and local livestock. Tauren shamans regard the paws as more than trophies, for they carry the land’s natural vitality and matter to the plains’ spiritual balance.

sections.title: Cleansing the Wells
sections.body: When goblin ventures tainted Mulgore’s sacred water reserves, shaman Mull Thunderhorn needed the land’s aid against the pollution. Joined with plainstrider talons, wolf paws lend spiritual resonance to cleansing totems. Once the totem is made, the work of purifying the Winterhoof Water Well can begin.

faq.q: What creatures drop a Prairie Wolf Paw?
aliases: where to get prairie wolf paws
faq.answer: Prairie wolves, prairie stalkers, and prairie wolf alphas hunt Mulgore’s plains, primarily southwest of Bloodhoof Village, and provide Prairie Wolf Paws.
Mull Thunderhorn, a tauren shaman in Bloodhoof Village, wants the paws to help make a cleansing totem for the tainted water wells.

faq.q: Why are wolf paws needed to cleanse water?
faq.answer: Tauren shamans call on the land’s natural vitality against corruption. Joined with bird talons, wolf paws bind Mulgore’s living spirit into an elemental totem that can purge goblin poisons.

faq.q: Which water well do these paws help cleanse?
faq.answer: The paws help make a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well, poisoned by goblin interlopers and their agents.

angles.text: As a tauren, you gather wolf paws in stewardship of the land. Its native beasts help heal ancestral water wells tainted by goblin greed.
As a shaman, you use cleansing totems made from local animal parts to draw on the land’s living essence and purge unnatural corruption.
